model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the relationship between Speed (Tokens/s) and Performance (Accuracy %) for various model configurations and Pareto fronts. The x-axis is labeled "Speed (Tokens/s)" and uses a linear scale with an observed data range from approximately 10 to 170, featuring numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 20. The y-axis is labeled "Performance (Accuracy %)", utilizing a linear scale with an observed range from approximately 60 to 85, and numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The plot contains five solid lines of different colors, each connecting data points that feature a specific sequence of marker shapes (cross, square, circle, plus, and triangle). The dark blue solid line ("L=512, S=512") starts at a cross marker near (9, 81), peaks at a plus marker near (16, 83.1), and ends at a triangle near (17, 82.5). The medium blue solid line ("L=512, S=256") begins at a cross near (18, 79.9), drops to a low at a plus marker near (31, 79.5), and ends at a high point with a triangle near (33, 81.2). The light blue solid line ("L=512, S=128") starts at a cross near (37, 75.4), peaks at a square near (44, 76.4), and declines to end at a plus marker near (59, 74.4). The dark salmon solid line ("L=128, S=64") begins at a cross near (45, 72.5), dips to a low at a circle near (78, 70.9), and rises slightly to end at a triangle near (98, 71.2). The light salmon solid line ("L=128, S=32") is relatively flat, starting at a cross near (92, 62.4) and gradually declining to end at a plus marker near (167, 61.6). Additionally, the plot features two dark grey lines representing Pareto fronts. The "LLaDA Pareto Front" is a dotted line connecting three cross markers, showing a steady downward trend from (9, 81) to (92, 62.4). The "Cache Pareto Front" is a dashed line connecting the upper-most points of the datasets, showing a continuous decline from a plus marker at (16, 83.1) down through a triangle at (33, 81.2), another triangle at (98, 71.2), and finally ending at a plus marker at (167, 61.6).

The y-axis is labeled "Performance (Accuracy %)" with a linear scale ranging from roughly 60 to 85, featuring numeric tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot contains five solid colored lines representing different L and S configurations, with markers indicating various refresh rates (cross for w/o Cache, square for Refresh=2, circle for Refresh=4, plus for Refresh=8, and triangle for Refresh=16).
